Distribution and habitat data. The species is known only from Wumengshan N. R. in northeast Yunnan. The specimen was collected by sifting leaf litter at an altitude of 1952 m. Comparative notes. The new species is distinguished from all the known species of Nazeris from Yunnan and adjacent area by the abdomen with fine microsculpture on all tergites; by the sternite VII with posterior margin slightly protrude in the middle (Fig. 3 B); and by the wide dorso-lateral apophyses in ventral view (Figs 3 D, E).
